Only in prepare(moves) when ensurePath returns Left(local_expansion_limit), register the exact requestId/requirementId and its original continuation Need. Require same generated scope as discoveryOnly, need.prefixMoves==initialPrefix, and need.horizon>=moves.size (failed edge still required) and <= attempted grouped horizon. No registration from merely used==maximum, absent work, a nonunique continuation, other prefix, or another failure reason.

After replay.retain and the existing readPrincipalVariations rebind when additions exist, refresh current fact readings. Mark only the registered owner that still needs that exact continuation Need and remains unresolved as wrapper state=stopped, stopReason=local_expansion_limit. Preserve its Result without modification. Already supported/contradicted/unneeded/invalid or now-satisfied shorter horizons are not marked.

Use the annotated retained/read job in the existing Right and beginResponses branches. FactReader already preserves stopped wrapper reason on later refresh; Proposal.finish already preserves local_expansion_limit. No replay request re-insertion or second continuation submission.
